nodes.label: niri include merge semantics (keyed FIRST wins, singleton LATER wins)
nodes.rationale: Blanket 'later wins' rule was wrong for output blocks; dms/outputs.kdl included first silently made cfg/display.kdl inert. Proven empirically 2026-08-25.

nodes.label: cfg/display.kdl (sole output source, VRR off)
nodes.rationale: Monitor flickers/luminosity-pulses under VRR even on-demand; VRR disabled entirely 2026-08-25.

nodes.label: DMS Display 'First Time Setup' one-click trap
nodes.rationale: fixOutputsInclude() re-adds the outputs include before cfg/display.kdl, restoring the flicker bug.
nodes.norm_label: dms display 'first time setup' one-click trap

nodes.label: Resolved 2026-08-24 cfg/ drift cleanup
nodes.rationale: cfg/*.kdl files were symlinked but never included; deleted, with genuinely-missing binds/rules ported and input.kdl restored.

nodes.label: DMS regeneration table (layout/alttab/wpblur every start)
nodes.rationale: Measured by restarting dms.service; regenerated files rebuild deterministically from settings.json, so hand edits are lost.

nodes.label: vjupdate --dms-export / --dms-import (DMS_MANUAL vs DMS_AUTO)
nodes.rationale: Blanket export reverted green focus-ring to DMS defaults in commit ff2cd4e unnoticed for two months; export now restricted to DMS_MANUAL.

nodes.label: Duplicate keybind silent reload failure
nodes.rationale: niri rejects the whole reload and keeps last-good config; only trace is journalctl KDL parse error.

nodes.label: scripts package stowed --no-folding (~/.local/bin unfolded)

nodes.label: Brave managed policy LoopbackNetworkAllowedForUrls (Discord to Vesktop arRPC)
nodes.rationale: Brave Preferences file is rewritten every session and untracked, so managed policy is the only declarative route.
